iut_type: End Products (Paramount Bed, 6 products sharing one Bluetooth module/stack but serving very different purposes)
customer_question: We want to register 6 products that share the same Bluetooth module and don't differ in stack/protocol, but they serve very different purposes (a bed control switch, a diaper-attached sensor, etc.). Can each of these have its own distinct Product Name even though they'll share one registration?
question_variants: Can products with very different physical uses but the same Bluetooth stack share one registration while keeping distinct names?
Does sharing a Design Name force all products to share the same Product Name too?
actual_issue: The customer had multiple physically and functionally distinct products (serving entirely different use cases despite sharing identical Bluetooth module/stack implementation) and needed to confirm the registration site could accommodate distinct, accurately-descriptive names for each individual product rather than forcing a single generic name across all of them.
plain_english_explanation: A registration requires exactly one overarching Design Name, but the individual entries within that registration's Product List can each carry their own distinct Product Name — so even though these 6 products share one Bluetooth registration (since their stack/protocol implementation is identical), each can still be labeled with a name that accurately reflects its own specific use case (e.g., a bed control switch product can have a different Product Name than a diaper-attached sensor product) within that single registration's Product List.
consultant_answer: Yes — your registration needs one overarching Design Name, but the individual Product List entries within that registration can each have their own distinct Product Name. So even though these 6 products share one Bluetooth registration, each can still be labeled with a name reflecting its own specific use case in the Product List.
decision_logic: Design Name and Product Name serve different registration-site purposes: Design Name is the single overarching identifier for the shared Bluetooth implementation, while Product Name entries within the Product List can be individually customized per actual product, even when many distinct products share one underlying registration.
final_recommendation: When a customer registers multiple functionally distinct products sharing identical Bluetooth implementation, clarify that Product Name flexibility exists at the individual Product List entry level, separate from the single shared Design Name, so each product can carry an accurately descriptive name.
risk_if_done_wrong: A customer mistakenly believing all products sharing one registration must use the identical name could end up with confusingly generic or inaccurate product labeling across functionally very different items.
